summary: Strong Modern Age lineup with convincing contemporary clothing, distinct everyday roles, a recognisable civic Mayor, and an unmistakably travelling tour guide. Preserve the overall designs; improve palette-independent readability and repair two prop connections before approval.
problems: The Plant Keeper's red-on-red apron straps lose contrast on the first wearer. Its identity depends too heavily on the small plant and thin pocket outlines.
The Mayor's scissors have gold handle loops that appear disconnected from the central hinge and blades. This weakens an otherwise effective ceremonial prop.
The tour guide's flagpole intersects the sleeve envelope: its centre is at z=0.09 while the sleeve extends to z=0.095. It needs clearance and an explicit hand grip.

The maintenance cap becomes almost indistinguishable from hair on the second wearer because its inherited brown colour blends with the head. The hi-vis vest remains clear, but the head silhouette is inconsistent.
fix: Plant Keeper: Retain the hoodie, cropped trousers and potted plant. Enlarge the apron into a continuous bib approximately 0.36 wide by 0.40 high, joining the straps, and give it a reliably contrasting light neutral or sage colour with one dark pocket. Remove the tiny drawstrings if they compete with the straps. Canvas-Jacket Neighbour: Keep the collar, rolled cuffs and phone; this kit already reads as a modern casual neighbour. Preserve the bright phone screen rather than adding smaller details. Sunhat Library Regular: Keep the broad pale hat, cardigan, book and tote; these provide a successful silhouette distinct from the canvas jacket. Maintain strong book-cover and bag contrast across wearer palettes. Town Maintenance Worker: Preserve the reflective vest and chunky toolbox. Give both caps a fixed contrasting workwear colour and a clearly projecting dark visor, rather than inheriting a skin-adjacent brown. Mayor of the Civic Ribbon: Keep the dark suit, broad gold sash and civic badge. Add two substantial gold shanks connecting the handle loops to the scissors' hinge, overlap the blade roots with that hinge, and ensure one handle is visibly held. Far-Routes Tour Guide: Preserve the mint hat, red scarf, flag and suitcase as the visitor signature. Move the flag shaft forward clear of the sleeve, approximately z=0.14–0.16, and add a connected gripping-hand shape around its lower end. Slightly enlarge the suitcase wheels so the luggage remains recognisable without its tiny stickers. Recheck all six kits at the intended 40° camera and actual stream size.
